subject.title: fix(discord): prevent stale gateway error listeners after restart

question: Should this PR keep the silent shared late-error guard, or should Discord post-dispose gateway errors still produce a non-retaining runtime diagnostic before merge?
rationale: Code review can verify that the guard bounds listener growth and prevents unhandled EventEmitter errors, but the observability tradeoff for late Discord gateway errors is a maintainer availability decision.

options.title: Accept shared guard after validation
options.body: Keep the current non-retaining guard and merge after exact-head CI confirms the availability-sensitive listener path remains clean.

options.title: Require retained diagnostics
options.body: Ask for a revision that removes disposed closures while still emitting a bounded runtime diagnostic for late post-dispose gateway errors.

options.title: Pause the listener ownership change
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a broader Discord gateway ownership refactor instead of a supervisor-local guard.

recommendation.title: Accept shared guard after validation
recommendation.body: Keep the current non-retaining guard and merge after exact-head CI confirms the availability-sensitive listener path remains clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the gateway-supervision centralization and committed or merged the prior late-error cleanup fixes that define this ownership boundary.
